fields.label: Field
fields.options:
VAT / Tax ID
Mobile Number
Postal Code
CR Number
fields.description: Postal Code is checked on the Address; the others on the master (a mobile also on its Contact).

fields.label: Check
fields.options:
Regular Expression
Exact Digits
Minimum Digits
Starts With
Ends With

fields.label: Value
fields.description: A number of digits, a prefix or suffix, or a regular expression (checked when the rule set is saved).

fields.label: Party Kind
fields.description: B2B: a customer with a VAT Registration Number on file, a Company supplier. B2C: the others.

fields.label: Credit
fields.description: Credit Customers Only: a customer with a Customer Credit Limit above zero. Suppliers are not asked.

fields.label: Company Country
fields.description: Blank: every company. The party's company is a customer's own Company, else the user's default company.

fields.label: Existing Values
fields.options:
New or Changed Values Only
All Values
fields.description: Only a new or changed value is checked by default, so an old master that already breaks the rule stays editable.
